flox-catalog.description: Versions the Flox catalog can actually resolve, unlike repology's nix_unstable which tracks nixpkgs directly and runs ahead of the flox/nixpkgs snapshots. Only versions built for every system in [options].systems are offered, so a bump cannot break the lock on one system.

customManagers.description: Bump every exact version pin in the Flox manifest. Requiring the value to start with a digit skips the >= ranges (which float on their own) and the inline-table pins go/granted (deliberately held). Pins may share a pkg-group only while a single catalog snapshot satisfies all of them; once they drift apart the group fails to lock with 'constraints too tight', so give each independently-bumped pin its own group.
Bump zap flake ref to the latest tagged release

packageRules.description: Retained from the repology era so a failed flox-relock check still gets retried. The flox-catalog datasource only offers resolvable versions, so this should become unnecessary; drop it after a few clean runs.
